open_science_requirements: Deliver FAIR data and link observation data to relevant data infrastructures, including, where applicable, the European Open Science Cloud (EOSC), the European Common Data Spaces and SAGE (CC-08, Scope p.75).
Deliver FAIR data, harmonisation workflows and processing protocols supporting data integration from genome to space, and link observation data to relevant data infrastructures (SR-04, Scope p.75).
Contribute to consensus and implementation of joint definitions of data collection, metadata and processing protocols, data quality, and harmonisation of standards (SR-05, Scope p.75).
